title: The Cold Vector Anew
author: Rosalind Crane
blurb: August Marchetti, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
